title: Meeting
subtitle: You get a transcript, structured minutes, and the same minutes in the other language — from a recording or a pasted transcript.
cap: Audio or video, up to 25 MB.
pastePlaceholder: Rina: let's start. The checkout error budget is at 2.1 percent…
noAsr: This gateway key lists no speech-to-text model, so a recording cannot be transcribed here. Paste the transcript and the minutes still work.
noFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed, so a recording cannot be read here. Paste the transcript instead.
emptyDetail: Create one, add the recording, and the minutes follow.
unverified: {count} name(s) the transcript never said were removed from these minutes.

record.sourceTabHint: Pick the tab your online meeting is in and tick “Share tab audio”, so the other people are recorded too.
record.capped: The 25 MB limit was reached, so the recording stopped there. Everything up to that point was kept.
record.queued: The recording is waiting to be uploaded…
record.uploadFailed: That recording was not uploaded. It is still here, so try again or save it to your device.

errors.insecure_context: Recording needs a secure page (https, or localhost). Upload a file instead.
errors.unsupported_browser: This browser cannot record audio. Use Chrome or Edge, or upload a file instead.
errors.permission_denied: The microphone was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, then try again.
errors.no_device: No microphone was found. Plug one in, or upload a file instead.
errors.display_unsupported: This browser cannot share tab audio. Record the microphone alone instead.
errors.display_cancelled: Nothing was shared, so the recording did not start.
errors.display_no_audio: That share carried no audio. Share a tab and tick “Share tab audio”, or record the microphone alone.
errors.recorder_failed: The recording stopped unexpectedly. Try again, or upload a file instead.
errors.empty_recording: Nothing was captured. Check that the right microphone is selected, then try again.

errors.noMeeting: Choose a meeting first, then this recording can be uploaded.
